via_policy: >=2 POWER vias (0.40 drill) per layer change; never a single via
return_path_requirement: adjacent In1 return under the whole run
basis: IPC-2221B 1oz 35um dT10K. IBAT_OCP 3.125 A is a trip threshold not a design current (CTO 2026-08-11). BAT_RAW/MID/SENSE added to the class at FBV2-P2-000 - they had matched no pattern since the fork.

via_policy: >=2 POWER vias (0.40 drill) per layer change; prefer ZERO - one outer layer end to end
return_path_requirement: adjacent In1 return under the whole run
max_practical_length_mm: 71 measured (the one long run PM-2 predicted)
basis: D-245 (FBV2-P2-002A). SCOPED TO THIS NET ONLY - class A is NOT changed. At ~71 mm this net is ~69 % of the whole protection path's copper resistance: 34.9 mOhm at the class 1.00 mm target against 23.3 mOhm at 1.50 mm, taking path copper from ~50.6 to ~38.9 mOhm and the 1.5 A copper loss from 114 to 88 mW. SHORT PAD-ESCAPE NECKS ARE PERMITTED AND MUST BE DOCUMENTED PER PAD: U18 is an MSOP-10 on 0.50 mm pitch with a 0.20 mm pad gap, so no trunk width can land on it directly. A neck is the shortest length that clears the package, never a traverse, and carries no thermal-relief or single-via bottleneck.

via_policy: >=2 POWER vias per layer change
basis: 1.0 A. LOCAL EXCEPTION: the U21 boost draws 2.19 A peak inductor current from SYS (D-185); size that segment from the peak. In2 permitted only if re-sized at 0.5 oz - never inherit the outer width.

via_policy: >=2 POWER vias per layer change
basis: 1.0 A design / 0.64 A measured peak. NFC_SUPPLY (U9 VDD+VDD_TX) added to the class at FBV2-P2-000. Fine-pitch escapes fall back to 0.20 mm inside the six named courtyards.

via_policy: >=2 POWER vias per layer change
basis: U22 TPS22950C ILIM set by R101 1.65k. Boost output; the 2.19 A peak lives on the SYS side not here.

via_policy: >=2 POWER vias per layer change
basis: 400 mA published continuous (D-086); 0.76 A typ ILIM at R_ILIM 1.5k. Split out of P3V3 at FBV2-P2-000 so the ledger states the real rail current.

via_policy: ZERO vias. In2 is forbidden outright.
return_path_requirement: solid In1 under the entire pair; no plane split or void crossed
basis: USB 2.0 FULL SPEED (ESP32-S3 has no HS PHY). t_r 4-20 ns -> critical length 100 mm. Intrinsic placement skew 2.4 mm = 17 ps. No impedance control, no length matching, no via required. 90 ohm geometry retained as good practice; STACKUP-TO-CONFIRM.

via_policy: <=2 vias per net
basis: 3-node bus, up to 80 MHz burst. MX-8 forbids simultaneous display and microSD. NO length matching and NO series damping: at 46 mm the round trip is 0.67 ns and the bus is 63 percent shorter than the Beta-DM bus that was accepted.

via_policy: <=2 vias per net; keep the three bus lines on the same layer through the trunk
basis: <=10 MHz (SX1262 16, CC1101 ~6.5, ST25R3916 ~10). Daisy-chain trunk U1 -> U9 -> U7 -> U8, NEVER a star; branch stubs <=10 mm. MX-1 gates concurrent TX. If bring-up shows ringing the lever is source series damping - a SCHEMATIC change needing CTO approval.

via_policy: <=2 vias per net
basis: HARD BUDGET, DERIVED: 2.2k pull-up, 400 kHz Fast-mode t_r <= 300 ns -> C_bus <= 300ns/(0.847*2200) = 161 pF. 8 devices at ~7 pF plus the FPC plus ~100 mm of plane-referenced copper is already close to it. Levers if measured C exceeds: run 100 kHz (C <= 537 pF, the bring-up target anyway) or lower the pull-ups - a SCHEMATIC change.

via_policy: <=1 via per net
basis: TCA4307 buffered segment, 1.5k pull-ups, 400 kHz max (SCPS270B - NOT 1 MHz). Budget <=200 pF at 400 kHz / <=400 pF at 100 kHz INCLUDING the accessory cable, so the on-board share must stay small. D2 TVS between the 22 R resistors and J5.

via_policy: <=2 vias per net
basis: BCLK ~3.07 MHz at 48 kHz/32 bit stereo. Trivial electrically. >=0.40 mm from any switch node (rule). Route BCLK/LRCLK/DIN as a group so the mic clock and data share a return.

via_policy: ZERO vias on NFC_RF and NFC_OSC (enforced). NFC_RX <=1 via.
return_path_requirement: In1 solid beneath the whole front end; no stitching lattice under the loop
max_practical_length_mm: arm A and arm B EQUAL to within 1 mm
basis: Width is set by SYMMETRY not heat - the coil current is ~187 mA and the thermal minimum is 0.036 mm. R_q is 1.1 ohm/arm and Q ~21 (D-204), so arm asymmetry is not absorbable. Bench tuning is mandated with the exact parts fitted.

via_policy: SW node: no via unless proven. LED string: normal vias.
return_path_requirement: loop closed locally at C44; In1 solid under L3
basis: TI SNVSA40B V_OVP_SW 36/37.5/39 V on an open-LED fault - that fault case is what justifies the 0.30 mm clearance and the 0.50 mm separation from USB and I2C. Normal operation 3.884-4.484 V.

via_policy: <=1 via; place a via pair at Q1 source
return_path_requirement: loop C12 -> R24 -> D1 -> Q1 -> In1 closed locally
basis: 150 mA nominal / 170 mA worst-case peak, ~17 mA averaged over an NEC command (D-161). Pulse loop is already local (9.28 mm); C12 22 uF at 18 mm is the bulk reservoir. IR_GATE spans 110.6 mm but is a low-current control line, not the pulse path.

nets: expander control, status, enables, test-point-only nets
via_policy: normal GENERAL_SIGNAL vias (0.30 drill), unrestricted count
basis: No timing constraint exists on any of these. Do not invent one.

nets: XGPIO0-9 + XGPIO0-9_HDR + NATIVE_A/B_HDR + WAKE_ATTN_N_HDR + WAKE_GATE_S + ACC_DETECT_N(_HDR)
via_policy: normal vias; the J5 inter-row channel is the crossing lane
basis: 3.3 V CMOS only. 100 R series on every XGPIO, both natives and ACC_DETECT_N; 330 R on WAKE; four TPD4E1B06 arrays cover all sixteen exposed signal contacts. Series R and TVS must sit BETWEEN the internal net and J5 - never after the connector.

via_policy: normal vias
basis: Strap levels are sampled once at reset, so a coupled glitch at power-up is a boot failure. Keep >=0.50 mm from every switch node and from LED_BOOST; keep the pull resistor at the pin, not at the far end of the net.

preferred_layers: same layer as its own IC
via_policy: NO via on any feedback node; <=1 via elsewhere
return_path_requirement: In1 solid beneath; keep the divider ground reference at the IC ground pin
basis: These are 0.4-3.65 Mohm divider and comparator nodes at micro-amp currents. MEASURED TODAY they span 72-96 mm (LTC_GATE 95.6, BAT_SENSE 96.5, VBRIDGE_TOP 90.1, LTC4368_FAULT_N 85.4, REF_HO 82.4, LTC_UV 81.7, VREF_TOP 80.8, VREC_VCC 81.2). Routing cannot fix that - see PM-2.

via_policy: >=1 dedicated via per connector GND pad; >=2 at every ESD, converter and RF ground pin; perimeter stitch <= 7 mm
return_path_requirement: In1 is the single continuous reference for every class above
basis: lambda/20 at 1 GHz in FR4 = 7.15 mm sets the perimeter stitch pitch. ONE authorised In1 void: the ESP32 antenna keepout, a 6.5 x 44 mm notch on the right edge over doc y 0..44. No stitching inside the antenna keepout, MIC_ACOUSTIC_KEEPOUT or either BOSS keepout.
